svg.text: CN10 USB-C: PRIMARY DEV PORT -- SWD + RTT debug, VCP console, 5V_STLK power in
flash + attach: mise run flash nucleo-n657x0 [--project net]
boot; JP1 + CN9 stay at defaults.
not JTAG/SWD; CN1/MIPI20 is the debug port
ST morpho CN3/CN15: most remaining I/O
Debug hookup: CN10 USB-C alone carries SWD, RTT, and the VCP; CN1 takes an external probe.
Arduino V3 header data: UM3417 Rev 3, Table 12. A0-A5 route through the on-board 3.3V-to-1.8V
adaptation amplifier; the 1.8V-domain ADC pin is shown. Morpho rows: odd/even pin names, Table 13.
